Nursing

Patient care, clinical skills and professional nursing development.

Three documented programmes span undergraduate nursing, nursing and midwifery, and advanced study following GNM.

01B.Sc NursingBachelor of Science in Nursing4 years→02GNMGeneral Nursing & Midwifery3 years→03Post Basic B.Sc NursingAdvanced nursing course after GNM2 years→

Rehabilitation & Physiotherapy

Movement, rehabilitation and physical recovery.

The Bachelor of Physiotherapy focuses on physical therapy and rehabilitation techniques.

04BPTBachelor of Physiotherapy4.5 years · including internship→

Medical Laboratory Sciences

Laboratory testing, diagnosis and medical reporting.

BMLT develops knowledge of clinical laboratory techniques supporting disease diagnosis and monitoring.

05BMLTBachelor of Medical Lab Technology3 years + 6-month internship→

Radiology & Imaging

Diagnostic imaging and treatment-planning support.

BMRIT covers X-ray, MRI, CT scanning and medical imaging techniques.

06BMRITBachelor of Medical Radiology & Imaging Technology3 years + 6-month internship→

Pharmacy

Medicines, pharmaceutical sciences and formulation.

B.Pharmacy covers medicines, drug formulation and medicine management for pharmacy and healthcare contexts.

07B.PharmacyBachelor of Pharmacy4 years→

Optometry

Eye care, vision testing and optical instruments.

B.Sc Optometry focuses on vision testing, eye care and the use of optical instruments.

08B.Sc OptometryBachelor of Science in Optometry3 years + 6-month internship→

Healthcare Support

Foundational patient-care assistance.

GDA is an entry-level healthcare course centred on assisting nurses and supporting patient care.
